title: Elevator Toot
premise: A hippo, a giraffe, a flamingo and one mouse share an elevator. A little green cloud appears. Everyone points at the mouse. The hippo is whistling.
visual: Cramped elevator with a floor-number dial. The giraffe's neck is folded flat along the ceiling. A pale green cartoon stink cloud with wavy lines hangs in the middle. The giraffe and flamingo are green-faced, pinching their noses and pointing at a tiny mouse holding up its paws. The hippo looks at the ceiling, whistling, innocent.
characterLean: Pairs with the building's elevator bits (the elevator that negotiates). The elevator could ding a floor nobody pressed.

motion: 6-8s. Ding. Small 'pfft' squeak. Cloud blooms. Heads turn one at a time to the mouse. Hippo whistles. Doors open; everyone else bursts out gasping; the hippo strolls out last.
notes: Kid-level gross: a cloud and green faces only. One squeaky sound, not a big one. The joke is the blame, not the toot.
